newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Kim approves final draft of reforms.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Kim approves final draft of reforms.

text.p: South Korean President Kim Young-sam on Saturday approved the final government draft of financial reforms submitted by the finance minister, a finance ministry spokesman said.
"President Kim approved the final draft of reforms without any comment," he said.

The final draft will be revealed to the public on Monday in a joint news conference by the Minister of Finance and Economy Kang Kyong-shik, the central Bank of Korea governor Lee Kyung-shick and the head of the Presidential Commission for Financial Reform Park Seong-yawng.

Earlier this month, the presidential commission studying financial reforms proposed granting more autonomy to financial institutions, increasing Central Bank independence and lifting various government regulations.
The commission also suggested that the banking, insurance and securities supervisory bodies should be unified under the authority of the prime minister.
